pageCache.text:

Our TLC Vision and Values
Through our Christian Values of Thinking with Thanksgiving, Learning with Love and Caring with Compassion, we will create an achievement culture for all, pursuing high expectations and promoting positive attitudes to learning.
Through our engaging curriculum we will develop the whole child, meeting the needs of each individual to prepare them for their future.
I can do all things through Christ because he gives me strength.
(Philippians 4 v 13)
Our Christian Values
Thinking with Thanksgiving Appreciating and considering our gifts as a blessing from God, we will try to:
Learning with Love Developing aspiration and attitudes that help us focus in the present and give us hope for the future, we will try to:
Caring with Compassion Following Jesus’ example, respecting and valuing differences in our community, we will try to:
Our children are helped to understand the biblical values of Thanksgiving, Love and Compassion through the following stories:
T - The Thankful Leper (Luke 17 v 11-19)
L - The Parable of the Prodigal Son (Luke 15 v 11-32)
C - The Parable of the Good Samaritan (Luke 10 v 25-37)
Our TLC Vision and Values
Develop our independence
See the good in ourselves and others
Use self-regulation and make good choices
Be resilient and learn from our mistakes
Forgive ourselves and others
Love learning together
Have integrity and be a good friend
Respect and look after the environment
Seek opportunity to help those in need
Horndean CE Junior School Vision and Values

pageCache.pageTitle: Vision and Values Groups | Horndean Church of England Junior School
pageCache.text:
Background Slideshow
Vision and Values Groups
We value the contribution which our children make to improving our school for everyone. Rather than just one 'School Council' we have established ten Vision and Values Groups. Each group is made up of a representative from each of our sixteen classes and each year children volunteer to become members of the Vision and Values Group which inspires them to make a difference.
Our Vision and Values Groups meet with staff and governors in the first week of each month to be courageous advocates of change.
Children's Christian Values Team (CCVT)
Working together to help develop and improve the Christian life of our school.
Safeguarding Guardians
Wellbeing Ambassadors
Promoting positive mental health, emotional and physical wellbeing for all by:​
Taking responsibility for helping others who need it​
Promoting ways of living a healthy and balanced life​
Promoting our TLC Value of 'Love learning together' by reviewing children's views of our important approaches such as homework and rewards.
Celebrating differences​
Welcoming new pupils​
Equalities Defenders
Promoting equality and diversity​
Defending fairness and respect​
Heroes of TLC and British Values
Presentation Prefects
Raising and upholding our standards for school uniform​
Inspiring others to present our school in the most positive light​
Helping reduce lost property in our school
Promoting our TLC Value of 'Respecting and looking after the environment' through:​
Completing wildlife surveys and nature spotting​
Deciding how we could improve our outdoor environment ​
Thinking about encouraging more wildlife into our school grounds
Being passionate about sport and inspiring others to succeed and engage in physical activities through:
Vision and Values Groups
Improving our Prayer Garden
Planning charity collections
Shining a light on worries
Highlighting safe choices
Pointing the way to safety
Keeping a lookout for each other
​Sharing strategies to help with self-regulation​
Planning competitions, activities and book awards
Helping classmates with book recommendations
Promoting active and healthy lifestyles
Encouraging everyone to participate in physical activities

pageCache.pageTitle: Wraparound Care | Horndean Church of England Junior School
pageCache.text:
Background Slideshow
Wraparound Care
We operate a Breakfast Club from 7.30am to 8.40am and an After School Club from 3:20pm to 4:30pm or 6:00pm every day. These clubs are held in our school hall and run by school staff.
All sessions are booked via the Arbor Parent Portal, a Parent User Guide is available if required to assist with booking and paying for sessions via the app.
For parents collecting siblings from Catherington CE Infant school or other local schools, children can join After School Club until 3.40pm to allow extra time for parents to collect them. This service is offered free of charge to our parents with children attending other schools. If parents using this provision do not collect their child by 3:40pm they will be charged for a 4:30pm After School Club session.
These sessions can also be booked via our Arbor Parent Portal.

Curriculum
We pride ourselves on providing a broad and balanced curriculum which reflects the National Curriculum, our Christian Values and the interests of our learners. Our Curriculum Overview and Year Team Learning Newsletters show how our curriculum is taught across our school. If you would like further information, please contact our Curriculum Leaders, through the school office. We believe that strong home school partnerships promote positive learning outcomes for our children and hold a number of Parent Learning Workshops each year. These informal evenings provide opportunities for us to share information about our teaching, learning and assessment with parents and copies of the presentations are available to download from the linked page.

Physical Education (PE)
Our children enjoy a range of fantastic opportunities within PE. Our specialist PE teachers teach every class for one of their two PE lessons each week and our PE Leaders organise a wide range of extra-curricular activities. Our sports teams enjoy high levels of success in local competitions and many of our pupils train at county level out of school and our Sports Leaders promote healthy life choices both in and out of school. Our children's sporting achievements are celebrated in our termly Sports Newsletters which can be found in the News and Events section of our website, via the link below.
Children throughout the school are members of one of our four House Teams - Chichester, Drake, Murray and Nelson. Our Sports Leaders researched the famous sailors our House Teams are named after and created a presentation to share with the school. This can be seen below.
